name: relay
description: Relay — production-ready Discord ticket bot by OpenForge

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');fs.copyFileSync('src/database/schema.sql','dist/database/schema.sql');const md='src/database/migrations';const od='dist/database/migrations';fs.mkdirSync(od,{recursive:true});for(const f of fs.readdirSync(md))fs.copyFileSync(path.join(md,f),path.join(od,f));"
